instruction: Implement `pub fn roman_to_int(s: &str) -> i64` in the target file, replacing the stub. It converts a valid Roman numeral string to its integer value, honouring subtractive notation (IV=4, IX=9, XL=40, XC=90, CD=400, CM=900). Symbol values: I=1, V=5, X=10, L=50, C=100, D=500, M=1000. Examples: roman_to_int("III")=3, roman_to_int("IV")=4, roman_to_int("IX")=9, roman_to_int("LVIII")=58, roman_to_int("MCMXCIV")=1994. Edit only this file.
